name: Dewroot
summary: A botanical skincare store where you drag the shelf and bottles leap, spin and drop into the bag
about: A soft, plant-themed skincare shop with a dripping-pipette hero, a draggable product shelf and a routine quiz that builds a three-step set. Bottles jump into the header bag with a spin and a sparkle, or you can flick one up and drop it in yourself. It also has a filterable shop, product pages where the scent refills the bottle, a bag with a promo code, checkout and an order confirmation, all in PKR.
how: Drag the shelf sideways (or use the arrows and dots); give it a throw and it springs to the nearest bottle.
Press Add, or flick a bottle up and drop it on the bag in the header: the lid pops, sparkles burst and the count bumps.
Answer the two-tap routine quiz, then add all three suggested bottles at once and watch them hop in one by one.
Open a product to pick 30, 50 or 100 ml and a scent; the liquid recolours and refills before it flies to the bag.
In the bag change quantities, remove lines and try the code GLOW12 for 12% off; delivery is free over PKR 4,000.
Check out with a Pakistani mobile number and city, place the order and enjoy the petals and bubbles.
